import unittest

from boltons.setutils import IndexedSet


class IndexedSetSliceRegressionTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.indexed = IndexedSet(range(20))
        self.indexed.remove(2)
        self.indexed.remove(7)
        self.current = list(self.indexed)

    def assertSliceMatchesList(self, key):
        result = self.indexed[key]
        self.assertIsInstance(result, IndexedSet)
        self.assertEqual(list(result), self.current[key])

    def test_positive_and_negative_bounds_after_removals(self):
        for key in (
                slice(1, 8),
                slice(-8, -1),
                slice(-12, 10),
                slice(3, -3)):
            with self.subTest(key=[REDACTED]
                self.assertSliceMatchesList(key)

    def test_positive_steps_agree_with_list_slicing(self):
        for key in (
                slice(None, None, 2),
                slice(1, 15, 3),
                slice(-15, -2, 4),
                slice(-100, 100, 3)):
            with self.subTest(key=[REDACTED]
                self.assertSliceMatchesList(key)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
